speaker: Moderator
text: To start how was onboarding for your team?

speaker: P3
text: Reliability is high. We have not had a major outage in two years.

speaker: P6
text: Onboarding took forever. Too many dashboards. I never know which one is the source of truth.

speaker: Moderator
text: Got it. What would you improve?

speaker: P3
text: A single export. Finance and research should not be reconciling two files every Friday.

speaker: P6
text: Search across past events. I still cannot find last quarter's transcript.

speaker: Moderator
text: How often do you use the dashboard?

speaker: P6
text: Maybe once a week unless a client asks.

speaker: Moderator
text: Would you recommend us to a peer?

speaker: P6
text: Yes if they have an analyst.

speaker: Interviewer
text: How was onboarding compared with the competitor?

speaker: Buyer
text: Implementation timeline lost us the deal more than price.

speaker: Buyer
text: Security review still came up twice. That slowed everything.

speaker: Security lead
text: We needed a named owner on your side. We did not get one until week three.

text: Would you recommend us to a peer?
